# Build output as mapped masks; arrays from the test input's object coordinates.
N=14
out=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
# 7 source pattern, core r11..17,c0..6; marker at r17,c6; extension at c3,r8..10
obj7={(r,c):7 for r in range(11,18) for c in range(7) if not (r==14 and c in (0,1)) and not (r==17 and c==6)}
obj7[(17,6)]=5
for r in range(8,11): obj7[(r,3)]=7
# rotate 180 within core coordinate system and extend relative to core
for (r,c),v in obj7.items():
    rr=6-(r-11); cc=6-c
    R=rr; C=cc
    if 0<=R<N and 0<=C<N: out[R][C]=v
# 3 source: core r1..7,c12..18; extension row4 c9..11
obj3={(r,c):3 for r in range(1,8) for c in range(12,19) if not (r>=5 and c==15)}
for c in range(9,12): obj3[(4,c)]=3
for (r,c),v in obj3.items():
    R=r-1; C=7+(c-12)
    if 0<=R<N and 0<=C<N: out[R][C]=v
# 2 core r0..6,c1..7, rotated 180 and placed at bottom-left
obj2={(r,c):2 for r in range(7) for c in range(1,8) if not ((r==0 and c==4) or (r==3 and c in (1,2,3)))}
for (r,c),v in obj2.items():
    R=7+(6-r); C=6-(c-1)
    out[R][C]=v
# 8 core r11..17 c9..15 plus protrusions; unchanged bottom-right
obj8={(r,c):8 for r in range(11,18) for c in range(9,16)}
obj8.update({(14,16):8,(18,12):8,(19,12):8})
for (r,c),v in obj8.items():
    R=7+(r-11); C=7+(c-9)
    if 0<=R<N and 0<=C<N: out[R][C]=v
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
